categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Dongxing Wisdom Medical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of surgical medical devices, focusing on staplers (including laparoscopic and open staplers), stapler components, and surgical equipment such as operating tables, surgical lights, and ceiling supply units. The company also acts as an agent for medical devices and low-value consumables from other brands. Recently, it has expanded into synthetic biology through its subsidiary Changzhou Dongxing Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes innovation in intelligent and automated medical devices, particularly in electric laparoscopic staplers using proprietary 'unequal height nail' technology. It has full industry chain capabilities from product design, mold development, precision parts manufacturing, assembly to quality control. Production follows a mixed model of make-to-order and stockpiling based on sales forecasts, with outsourcing for non-core processes like sterilization. The company also invests in R&D for advanced products such as ultrasonic scalpels, absorbable tissue clips, and intelligent feedback systems for staplers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large tertiary hospitals across China such as Huashan Hospital, Renji Hospital, and Xiangya Hospital, as well as international markets in Europe, South America, the Middle East, and Africa. The company serves surgical departments requiring high-value consumables and equipment, including gastrointestinal, thoracic, hepatobiliary, and colorectal surgery. It also supplies medical device manufacturers with stapler components. The overseas market is targeted with differentiated strategies based on local policies and healthcare environments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with strong presence in the Yangtze River Delta region, including Changzhou, Suzhou, Wuxi, and Shanghai. It also has growing international sales in Europe, South America, the Middle East, Africa, and emerging markets such as Brazil. Domestic sales cover East China, North China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, South China, and Northeast regions. The company actively participates in international medical device exhibitions and forums to expand overseas presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Dongxing operates across the full supply chain of surgical staplers and related medical devices, from upstream precision parts manufacturing (via its subsidiary Zihang Precision) through midstream product assembly and manufacturing to downstream sales and distribution. It controls core technologies and production processes, enabling integrated product development and quality control. The company also acts as a distributor for third-party medical devices and consumables.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent, automated, and electric laparoscopic staplers, ultrasonic scalpels, and absorbable medical materials. It pursues integration of medical and engineering research with academia and industry. R&D efforts include expanding product lines with new stapler designs, electric hemorrhoidal ligators, and synthetic biology products like recombinant humanized collagen and mussel adhesive proteins. It aims to build a leading surgical device R&D center and enhance mold manufacturing capabilities to improve product quality and cost efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of self-developed surgical staplers, stapler components, surgical equipment, and agency sales of medical devices and low-value consumables. The company uses both direct sales to medical device manufacturers and hospitals, and indirect sales through distributors and dealers. It also earns investment income from financial assets. The sales model includes traditional distribution, two-invoice system, and secondary distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Johnson & Johnson (Ethicon) and Medtronic, especially in the high-tech laparoscopic stapler market. Domestically, it is a leading player in the stapler segment with recognized technology and quality, actively increasing market share through innovation and competitive pricing. It is among the earliest domestic adopters of advanced stapler technologies and participates in national industry standards development, positioning itself as a key domestic brand in minimally invasive surgical devices.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 435.46 million, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 97.42 million, showing stable growth compared to the previous year. The electric laparoscopic stapler product sales grew by 131.92%. Total assets reached RMB 2.48 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 2.25 billion. The company maintains a steady R&D investment of over RMB 22 million annually, representing about 5.15% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative surgical staplers with advanced features such as unequal height titanium nails for better tissue adaptation, electric operation for ease and safety, and intelligent feedback systems to enhance surgical precision and reduce complications. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering laparoscopic and open staplers, components, and surgical equipment with strong customization and quality control. Its integrated industry chain and focus on import substitution provide cost advantages and reliable supply, appealing to both domestic and international customers seeking cutting-edge minimally invasive surgical solutions.
